tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Learn what you will build, the workshop scope, and the required prerequisites.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to your Oracle Cloud account and prepare to use your tenancy.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Create the OCI Oracle Linux, Apache, PHP, and MySQL HeatWave Environment
tutorials.description: Create Oracle Linux, Apache, PHP, and a private MySQL HeatWave DB System configured for MySQL HeatWave GenAI.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Create the Database Schema for Inputs, Reviews, Results, and Audit History
tutorials.description: Create tables in the MySQL HeatWave DB System for complete RHEL and Oracle Linux freeform inputs, reviewed lines, results, rule versions, and workflow events.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Build the PHP Input and Saved Comparison Review Pages
tutorials.description: Build separate RHEL and Oracle Linux inputs that accept and save complete freeform SKU text in the MySQL HeatWave DB System.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Use MySQL HeatWave GenAI to Format Complete Inputs and Build the Representative Review Page
tutorials.description: Use ML_GENERATE to convert the complete text from both freeform SKU inputs into validated suggestions for human review.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Align Confirmed RHEL and Oracle Linux Lines and Build the Cost Results Page
tutorials.description: Align representative-confirmed lines created from both complete inputs and calculate traceable subscription-cost results.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Test, Deploy, and Demonstrate the Complete Application Workflow
tutorials.description: Test the full workflow and rehearse the prototype demonstration.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common problems and find directions for receiving help.
